title: Investigating laser-induced bond breaking in high-density polyethylene pyrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21089-21107
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02920A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rao Adeel Un Nabi, Hassan Abbas Khawaja, Yaoxiang Liu, Chaopeng Yang, Tie-Jun Wang
Three laser harmonics (1064, 532, 266 nm) broke HDPE bonds, with 266 nm effectively cleaving C–H bonds, shown by strong Hα emission at 656.3 nm and higher electron density/temperature.
